decisions.question: Whether you may restart or change anything on the machines
decisions.answer: Don't restart or change anything yet. Just find out why and tell me.

transcript.text: m3 is way slower than m1, m2 and m4 at the nightly build, even though they're supposed to be identical. Everything we collected is in investigation/. Why is m3 slow?

I've narrowed it down to two candidates, and the files in `investigation/` can't separate them:

- `/var/build` on m3 is at 97% (the others are at 41 to 55%);
- m3 mounts `/var/build` without `noatime`, so every read also writes.

Either would slow the cache step. To tell you which one it actually is, I need to restart the build agent on m3 with I/O tracing on (about 10 minutes, it interrupts any build running there). Is it OK to restart it?
Don't restart or change anything yet. Just find out why and tell me.
Understood, not touching anything. Going back through the notes.
